s: With the proliferation of cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI), machine-learning and technology enabled experimental drug discovery engineering platforms, this trend is expected to further accelerate, leading to more rapid engineering of potential molecules against disease targets, reducing expensive failure rates and lowering costs of early development.

In addition, in 2021, we have entered into multiple drug engineering collaborations with cutting-edge technology platform companies including leading technology enabled experimental platforms, machine-learning computational platforms and physics based computational platforms, to efficiently engineer molecules against well-specified targets for important chronic and life-threatening conditions.
